result.summary: Found 1 visually broken issue: a restaurant card is showing invalid pricing data ('€NaN delivery'), which makes the page look broken and undermines trust.

issues.description: The 'Smash Bros Burgers' card displays '€NaN delivery' instead of a real delivery fee.
issues.suggestion: Fix the data binding or fallback logic so missing/invalid delivery fees render as a valid price, 'Free delivery', or a neutral placeholder.
